name: toolkit_documentmanager_tests
description: Document Manager のテスト(node:test + Playwright API)。アプリ本体(app/)とは別管理で、コンテナイメージには含めない

scripts.test: node --test test/unit.test.js test/security.test.js test/mockup-zip.test.js test/mockups.test.js test/mockup-storage.test.js test/mockup-token.test.js test/skill-download-token.test.js test/project-manifest.test.js test/db-integrity.test.js test/db-migration.test.js test/office-render.test.js test/html-pdf.test.js test/storage-discard.test.js test/deploy.test.js test/integration-sqlite.test.js test/api-spec.test.js test/upload-accept.test.js test/miro-connection.test.js test/miro-connection-env.test.js test/miro-layout.test.js test/miro-layout-plan.test.js test/miro-diagram.test.js test/rate-limit.test.js test/runtime-info.test.js test/admin-api.test.js
scripts.test:discard:container: docker build -q -t dm-app:discard-test . && docker run --rm --entrypoint node -e APP_DIR=/app -e DISCARD_PORT=8081 -v "%cd%/test/integration-upload-discard.js:/tmp/t.js:ro" dm-app:discard-test /tmp/t.js
